ITEM 1 | Dark purple-brown whole olives, glossy and smooth-skinned, about 10 pieces clustered on the left side of the plate, each roughly 2 cm long, slightly wrinkled skin with a moist sheen | 60
ITEM 2 | Baked rectangular slab with golden-orange top, browned and bubbly in spots with red-orange sauce streaks, pale cream interior visible at edges, soft and set, roughly 7 cm by 5 cm and about 2 cm thick | 140
ITEM 3 | Brown-and-tan rice-like grains with reddish-brown bits mixed in, slightly clumped and matte, spread in a mound about 8 cm by 5 cm and about 1.5 cm high, partly beside a dark green leafy garnish | 110
ITEM 4 | Pale yellow cubes of potato-like starch with golden browned edges and a light sheen, about 2 to 3 cm pieces, firm and holding shape, two or three chunks grouped near center | 70
ITEM 5 | Thin irregular wedges and slices of pale yellow hard cheese with slightly crumbly edges and matte surface, scattered in a cluster about 8 cm across, each piece about 3 to 4 cm long and 0.5 cm thick | 50
ITEM 6 | Dark green wilted leafy greens with bright green edges and a slightly glossy surface, small folded clumps about 4 cm long, sitting between potato pieces and rice | 15
